before: 删除实例标识；下次请求官方服务时生成新的，与此前的上报和评分不再关联。
after: Delete the instance identifier; the next official-service request creates a new one, no longer associated with earlier reports or ratings.

before: 标记引导已看过。幂等 —— 跳过/看完/关闭三条退出路径都打到这里。
after: Mark onboarding as seen. Idempotent: skip, finish, and close exit paths all call this endpoint.

before: 引导是否已看过。未设置视为未看过 —— 前端据此决定是否自动弹出。
after: Whether onboarding has been seen. Unset means unseen; the frontend uses this to decide whether to open it automatically.

before:
提交广告/短片整份生成，返回生成批次。

``regenerate`` 时已有正式脚本而未带（或带了过期的）``overwrite_revision`` 返回 409，诊断里的
``script_overwrite`` 列出将被移除的条目与产物、渲染好的 ``text`` 和认可令牌 ``revision``，不提交任务。
after:
Submit full ad / short-film generation, returning a generation batch.

If ``regenerate`` encounters an existing formal script and ``overwrite_revision`` is absent or stale, return 409 without
submitting tasks. Diagnostic ``script_overwrite`` lists entries and artifacts to remove, rendered ``text``, and the
acceptance token ``revision``.

before:
保存附加指令并提交提示词编写，返回生成批次。

显式重写会替换已有视觉层内容而未带（或带了过期的）``overwrite_revision`` 时 409，诊断里的
``prompt_overwrite`` 列出将被覆盖的条目与字段、渲染好的 ``text`` 和认可令牌 ``revision``，不提交任务。
after:
Save additional instructions and submit prompt authoring, returning a generation batch.

When explicit rewriting would replace existing visual content and ``overwrite_revision`` is absent or stale, return 409
without submitting tasks. Diagnostic ``prompt_overwrite`` lists entries and fields to overwrite, rendered ``text``, and
the acceptance token ``revision``.

after: Save only this episode’s additional instructions for the “Hand to Agent” path, without submitting generation.

before:

after:

The new script plan replaces this episode’s entire existing plan and draft; the caller is responsible for deciding whether to confirm with the user first.
